svg.title: Quiet, Please
svg.desc: A mischievous pelican pedals a bicycle directly over the viewer in a narrow library aisle. Towering bookshelves converge toward the ceiling in an extreme worm's-eye perspective. Foreshortened wheels, enormous webbed feet, and the underside of the pelican's pouch loom overhead. A single articulated desk lamp, with a lemon-yellow interior, casts hard light and sharp black shadows.
